librerareader.description:
Librera Reader is a customizable, open-source eBook and document reader for Android. Open PDF, EPUB, EPUB3, MOBI, AZW, AZW3, DjVu, FB2, TXT, RTF, HTML, DOC, DOCX, CBZ, and CBR files in one versatile application, with support for online OPDS book catalogs.

Organize your reading collection by scanning selected folders, browsing cover grids or lists, and tracking recently opened books. Adjust fonts, colors, margins, brightness, and day or night themes to create a comfortable reading environment. Built-in tools include bookmarks, annotations, document search, dictionaries, text selection, and configurable navigation controls.

Librera also provides text-to-speech reading, adjustable automatic scrolling, and a musician-friendly hands-free reading mode. Import and export settings to preserve your preferred configuration.

The F-Droid edition excludes Google Play services and Google Drive synchronization. Some functions depend on installed speech engines, supported document formats, and the selected APK variant. Librera is distributed as free and open-source software under the GNU GPL.
